description:
Files:


Functional specifications:
Review lifecycle, connector isolation, sync, permissions and Action reuse; fix findings. After PR review approval run coverage-upper handoff, review resulting changes before merge. Commit/push/merge still require authorization.

Tests before implementation:
- Fresh coverage-guided failure-path tests

Branches validated:
- review findings
- lifecycle failures
- isolation
- replay

Documentation:
- Beadwork/PR coverage evidence and exceptions

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable to review/coverage-only work; verify no duplicated operations or boundary bypass.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

comments.text: Pre-final adversarial review: account/config isolation, storage confidentiality, replay and generic pairing states traced. Two proven new integration defects recorded as .10 (LID mentions; connection.ex own_address uses me.id while privacy mentions use me.lid) and .11 (Connection.update_creds ignores Storage.put error, allowing non-durable state). Base has no WhatsApp path. Existing tests missed alternate own identity and final write caller continuation. No E2E approval yet; complete final review/coverage after approved E2E.
